description: Source paths that exist in both schema_forge_core and schema_forge (ETP-4980). `divergent` lists copies that already drifted and are NOT yet consolidated: each needs an owner decision and a call-site migration, never a whole-file copy. `identical` lists copies that are still byte-equal and are kept in sync only by the check in scripts/check-cross-repo-duplicates.mjs. Remove an entry when the file is consolidated; the check fails on stale entries.

divergent.cli/src/db.js: divergent API: core adds sweepCache/getCacheDrift/reportCacheDrift/resolveCacheDir/applyCacheModeFromEnv and renames DEFAULT_CACHE_PATH to DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR; schema_forge call sites must migrate
divergent.cli/src/data-fixes/run.js: divergent: schema_forge has features core lacks and vice versa; needs owner decision

identical.cli/src/data-fixes/lib/sampledata-xml.js: pending move into the published CLI package
identical.scripts/etp-4177-tax-migration/gen-obtl-: one-off migration script, run from the repo checkout
identical.scripts/run-sequence-generator-cloud.mjs: operational script, run from the repo checkout
identical.scripts/selector-inventory.js: operational script, run from the repo checkout
